The Light Commercial Tower is a 10-storey commercial complex located in the Arjan district of Dubailand. The project was developed by ACW Holdings.
In addition to office space, the building has a conference room with arched windows that can be used to host meetings and events. The first and second floors are dedicated to retail space, and the remaining floors house offices that vary in configuration. Units range in size from 45 sq. m (486 sq. ft) to 72 sq. m (775 sq. ft). Each floor has bathrooms, kitchens, and dining areas, and superior offices come with balconies, kitchens, bathrooms, and pantries.

The Light Commercial Tower is an exclusive mixed-use freehold commercial and retail tower located in one of Dubai's most exciting and emerging districts Arjan in the heart of New Dubai. This new direction in freehold property development for ACW Holdings represents our unwavering commitment to produce high-yield opportunities for our investors to capitalise on the potential of Dubai's high growth commercial and retail sector.

Lifestyle amenities such as restaurants, cafes, and fitness facilities are available within the tower. 


Motor City is a self-contained community with shopping, dining, healthcare, schools, and parks, supporting both businesses and residents. The area is known for its cobblestone pathways, greenery, and a calm environment compared to busier commercial districts. Nearby destinations include Dubai Autodrome, Sports City, and Dubai Studio City, as well as leisure attractions and themed experiences.

Established in 2005, PrimeLinks Real Estate specializes in commercial and investment properties across the UAE and the region. Location and Connectivity:

One Lake Plaza is positioned in Cluster T of Jumeirah Lake Towers, one of Dubai's most dynamic mixed-use communities built around three scenic artificial lakes. The building sits within the DMCC free zone along Sheikh Zayed Road, placing it at the heart of a thriving business and lifestyle hub. The Sobha Realty and DMCC Metro Stations are both within walking distance, making daily commuting effortless. JLT's pedestrian-friendly layout means residents and professionals can easily stroll to lakeside cafes, outdoor dining terraces, and community retail. Dubai Marina, JBR Beach, Emirates Golf Club, and Palm Jumeirah are all in close proximity, while major retail destinations including Dubai Marina Mall and Ibn Battuta Mall are easily reachable. With its seamless connectivity, vibrant street-level energy, and waterfront setting, JLT continues to be one of Dubai's most sought-after addresses for professionals.

For more details or to arrange a viewing, please contact Eisa Irfan Furniturewala.
